prompts.archive.png: A wide 16:9 background illustration for the original PC survival game After the Ebb. An abandoned coastal tidal records archive after the sea disappeared: long rows of steel rolling shelves, drawers pulled open, a strip of red survey tape running from a drawer to an old mechanical tide gauge on a desk, stacks of swollen charts hung to dry, a pale high window casting a broad wedge of light on mineral-salted floor. No humans, no readable text, no UI. Graphite and white chalk crosshatching on grainy gray paper, realistic ruined architecture, sparse desaturated petrol blue and rust watercolor, oppressive cold silence. Keep midtones clearly readable, pale overcast light, detail visible in shelves; not pitch dark, not cozy, not cute. Landscape cinematic composition with distinctive vertical archive cabinets.
